literal: Exceedingly established support possessors even if (they are), they will not survive, excellently endowed great-ones if they are angry.
translation: Even if they possess overwhelmingly strong support, they will not survive if men of eminent greatness become angry.
modern: அளவுகடந்த வலிமையான பாதுகாப்பை உடையவராக இருந்தாலும், சிறந்த பெருமைகளை உடைய பெரியவர்கள் சினங்கொண்டால் அவர்கள் தப்ப மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet warns against incurring the wrath of truly great people. The phrase 'இறந்து அமைந்த சார்பு' refers to having overwhelmingly strong support or protection, such as wealth, armies, or fortifications. However, the poet asserts that even such immense power is useless ('உய்யார்') against the anger of those who possess eminent greatness ('சிறந்து அமைந்த சீரார்'). The word 'செறின்' means 'if they become angry' or 'if they decide to destroy', emphasizing that the moral and spiritual power of the great can easily overcome any material defense.
